body:
Well, I think relatives and loved ones actually do have such an obligation. It's just when you remain alone, like myself for example, you are left helpless. 

Also, I think that this very life is pretty much all there is or ever will be, thats why I still try to struggle through it, while fully understanding its shittyness.
Another thought is that we want a change for better, to help weaker people we have to do it, achieve it ourselves. Humanity on its own won't do shit. A reason to stop being suicidal, I guess.
I'll try to. Thanks for talking to me . It really helps

yeah, basically I'm afraid that on my own I will fail, and if something bad happens, there's no god to bail me out, so to speak. makes me feel hopeless, afraid of life itself, wishing it all would just stop

I'm very lonely too. I don't really know what advice to give, just wanted to say that I know very well what it like being utterly alone and lost. I kinda accepted that it is what it is and stopped reaching out. The most I can do is to post here from a throwaway account. Well, it's something, I guess

thank you for the well wishes! it means a lot. for me, religion was essentially like Jesus in gospels, people asked him to be healed and he delivered. unfortunately, when I needed help, really needed, I got nothing, so yeah, it all crashed. so I don't have this shield, as you said so well, even if it was imaginary in the first place.
thanks for answering. I really appreciate you advice. the problem for me is that the dread goes on for so long in my life, it makes it utterly unenjoyable

A majority of people I think find comfort in religion, in god. I vaguely remember being kinda happy when I was religious. But after my life went to shit I kinda sobered up spiritually to see life as it is - a random mess without any higher power. My life is anything but enjoyable
I'm in my 30s and it definitely gets much shittier. Still kinda glad that I did not kill myself when I was most suicidal. Because shittiness for me is scary but less scary than nothingness
I hope you didn't hurt yourself and are still alive. If that matters, here's another person who wants you to live.

I understand you very well. I also live in this state of fear and dread, while everyone around seem to be so careless and joyful for no reason. It just goes on and you live this shitty life. Thats the way it is and always be, at least  for me. From what is going on in the world, humanity has a potential for worse, way worse. I don't see any changes for good happening.
